rows.label: Zanuka Hunter Beacon
rows.note: the one reliable accelerator; buy as many as you can afford

conditions: A beacon does nothing in Invasion missions and cannot be traded. Use it on the gear wheel in any other mission where assassins can spawn; one beacon covers the squad.

groups.sub: Survival or Capture; Void Fissures and Steel Path also work
groups.activity: wait out the first 5 minutes, then kill the Zanuka Hunter
groups.meta: restart if it has not appeared by 5:00
conditions: With the Death Mark the Hunter has roughly a 1.5% chance to spawn in the first 5 minutes of a Corpus-enemy mission, plus 0.5% per extra marked squadmate. A failed spawn does not use up the mark.
Each kill drops only one item: a part, the Blueprint or the Scimitar Avionics Blueprint (17.65%, useless here), so duplicates happen.
No assassins in Assassination, Syndicate, Arena, Sortie, Archimedea, Landscape, Archwing, Empyrean or Sanctuary Onslaught missions, and beacons cannot override that.
Being captured sends you to a Recovery mission to retrieve your gear.
bonuses: Marked squadmates raise the spawn chance, so Corpus Invasion squads in recruit chat are the usual way to run it.

disclosures.title: making the fight safe
disclosures.body: Trinity's Energy Vampire stun-locks the Hunter and Ivara's Sleep Arrows work, but Prowl does not. A knockdown such as Nekros Soul Punch or a big melee slam lets you chain knockdowns. It is immune to hard crowd control like Mag Pull or Radial Blind. Loot abilities work on it, so Khora is viable.

disclosures.title: how long it takes
disclosures.body: Reports run from about 3 kills in 3 hours for a whole Detron to 2 weeks or more; one player needed 4 beacons for the Detron against 11 for the Brakk. Solo Death Mark spawns are described as a long slog.

conditions: Have the resources ready before the Blueprint drops so the build starts at once.
